name: globnotes
description: A self-hosted, database-less note taking web app over a flat folder of markdown files. Obsidian-faithful links, multi-vault, plugins, white-label branding. Fork of flatnotes. Authentication is set up on first run via the built-in wizard.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Host path for your notes vault (markdown tree). Unless App data is set below, globnotes also keeps its settings, search index, branding and plugins in a .globnotes folder inside it.

paths.name: App data
paths.description: Optional. Keeps globnotes' settings, search index, branding and plugins outside your notes, e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/globnotes-state, so Appdata Backup and your notes backup can each cover their own part. Also set App data location to /state. Moving an existing install: stop the container and copy the contents of the .globnotes folder from your notes here first, otherwise the setup wizard starts again. See https://github.com/alexindigo/globnotes#keep-application-state-outside-your-notes

variables.name: App data location
variables.description: Optional. Set to /state when you use App data above; leave empty to keep app data in the .globnotes folder inside your notes.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: User the app runs as. Unraid default 99 (nobody). Must have write access to the Data path.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: Group the app runs as. Unraid default 100 (users).
